title: What Is Circular Reasoning?
skills: identify arguments in which the conclusion is assumed within the premise
distinguish genuine evidence from restated claims
evaluate arguments for logical support and independent justification
alignment_note: Explains circular reasoning as a logical fallacy in which a claim is supported by reasoning that ultimately depends on the same claim. Supports fallacy recognition, argument analysis, critical thinking, rhetorical literacy, and evaluation of evidence across high school English courses.
